'''R4-C4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A unit with a "flower pot"&ndash;shaped head almost as tall as its body, the droid was fitted with extra processing power to calculate [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates.

==Behind the scenes==
R4-C4 appears briefly in "[[Evil Plans]]" during the scene in which the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] is negotiating a price for [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]] with the [[Khramboan/Legends|Khramboan]] vendor [[Droogan/Legends|Droogan]].
